units: <cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 20:1">Pesik. R. s. 20</cite>, end <he>ג׳ מלאכים</he> a troop of angels.

<cite ref="Berakhot 3b">Ber. 3ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Sanhedrin 16a:20">Snh. 16ᵃ</cite> <he>לכו ופשטו ידיכם בג׳</he> go ye and stretch your hands out (for booty) as a band (of marauders). Pesik. R. l. c. <he>ג׳ של מלאכי חבלה</he> a troop of angels of destruction.—Pl. <cite ref="C00175"><he>גְּדוּדִים</he></cite>, <cite ref="C00175"><he>גְּדוּדִין</he></cite>. Ib.

<cite ref="Berakhot 29b:11">Ber. 29ᵇ</cite> <he>במקום גְּדוּדֵי חיה וכ׳</he> in a place where there are hords of wild beasts or robbers; <cite ref="Tosefta Berakhot 3:11">Tosef. ib. III, 11</cite> Var. ed. Zuck.
